name: private-bookmark
description: Private bookmarks and visit history stored locally in Chrome using SQLite WASM.

scripts.start: npm run copy:static && parcel watch popup.html add.html view.html options.html history.html sql.html background.js --no-cache --no-hmr --dist-dir build
scripts.build: npm run clean && parcel build popup.html add.html view.html options.html history.html sql.html background.js --no-cache --dist-dir build --no-source-maps && npm run copy:static
